scope: Default-off diagnostic capture of real GLM-5.2 512-wide post-normalization compact-KV latents, matching low-rank queries, and attention selections. This is an offline falsifier input, not a fidelity or context-capability result.

production_test.red_result: 6 tests ran: 2 failures and 4 errors because the unchanged W7-qualified engine has no W9 CLI mode, no real KV/query capture boundaries, and no persistent pinned readback staging.

capture_contract.kv_boundary: batch_kv_norm after RMS normalization and successful production compact-KV store
capture_contract.query_boundary: batch_qk_low after production low-rank query projection and before indexed attention
capture_contract.selected_boundary: the exact last_indexer_selected tensor consumed by the same attention call

implementation_constraints: The mode is absent by default and requires the explicit DS4_GLM_W9_CAPTURE_DIR CLI diagnostic environment variable.
No prompt text, fixture name, token ID, request hash, or model digest may select a production branch.
All device-to-host copies use staging allocated once with pinned-host allocation and freed only at capture finalization.
The destination directory must be new; every artifact is created with exclusive no-follow semantics and fsynced before the completion marker.
Any short readback, duplicate row, missing layer/position, short file, non-finite value, publication error, or survivor fails the diagnostic without producing W9_CAPTURE_COMPLETE.
The capture-disabled and capture-enabled arms use the same source, binary, model, tokenizer, prompt tokens, and deterministic dispatch. Final logits and output must be byte-identical.

offline_falsifier.metric: sqrt(sum((q dot (quantized_k - k))^2) / sum((q dot k)^2)) over held-out captured layer/query/key pairs
candidates: rotation plus a frozen per-channel linear correction fitted only on the calibration split
offline_falsifier.split: Freeze disjoint calibration and held-out row/query indices from post-capture public randomness before fitting any rotation/correction parameter.
offline_falsifier.decision: Stop W9 before kernel work if no candidate has held-out query-weighted relative RMSE <= 0.05. Passing only authorizes the 100-case paired NLL/top-1 gate; it does not authorize adoption.

acceptance_formula.capture_pass: all exact shape/count/dtype/boundary, fresh-publication, finite-data, pinned-staging, byte-identity, containment, and artifact-binding checks are true
acceptance_formula.offline_pass: real_capture == true and capture_width == 512 and query_weighted_error <= 0.05 on the frozen held-out split
acceptance_formula.terminal_rule: Missing or malformed artifacts, duplicate rows, unequal fixtures, non-finite values, scorer failure, timeout, OOM, Xid, swap growth, or a surviving process is FAIL. If capture passes but the offline metric fails, W9 closes as a supported negative result with no kernel implementation.

fidelity: The capture mechanism is byte-identical and needs no NLL gate. Any packed FP4 serving candidate is lossy and must pass the fixed 100-case paired NLL/top-1 gate before performance measurement or adoption.
